name: run
description: Launch the evaluator pipeline via `scripts/start.sh` after preflight passes: generate the per-job LiteLLM config from `runtime_info.input.litellm_proxy`, start the LiteLLM proxy on the configured port, then run the Harbor job with the configured dataset/version and registry path, together with any `--exclude-task-name` flags from `HARBOR_EXCLUDE_TASKS`. Long-running. Stamps live state into `artifacts/index.yaml` via `scripts/archive_run.sh`. Triggers on phrases like "run evaluator", "launch evaluator", "run swebench", "evaluate the model", "kick off the evaluator benchmark".
